enabled.name: Enable TBG bubbles
enabled.hint: Master switch for the bubbles: the ones over the tokens, the speech with no token in the middle of the screen, the sheet action bubble and the typing badge. The narrator bubble has its own switch. The chat bar and the scene history keep working.

debug.name: Debug logging
debug.hint: Print verbose TBG logs to the browser console. This client only.

bubbleLayout.name: Bubble stacking
bubbleLayout.hint: Free flow: a new bubble only pushes the bubbles it overlaps, so distant groups form their own columns. Line by line: every bubble on the scene moves up.

bubbleRiseSpeed.name: Rise speed
bubbleRiseSpeed.hint: Screen pixels per second that bubbles drift upward, over the tokens and in the middle of the screen. The default, 15, is slow, to leave time to read. Zero keeps them in place until newer bubbles push them.

bubbleRiseLimit.name: Rise limit
bubbleRiseLimit.hint: Screen pixels above the token after which a bubble fades out.

bubbleMaxLifetime.name: Maximum lifetime
bubbleMaxLifetime.hint: Seconds before a bubble fades regardless of position. Zero disables the limit.

bubbleScaling.name: Bubble scale
bubbleScaling.hint: Screen: bubbles keep the same size at any zoom level. World: bubbles scale with the map like the core bubbles.

bubblePortrait.name: Portrait in bubbles
bubblePortrait.hint: Show the token image inside the bubble, next to the name.

typingIndicator.name: Show who is typing
typingIndicator.hint: While someone writes in the chat bar, an ellipsis badge appears in the corner of their token. It disappears when the message is sent, when the input loses focus, or after three seconds without typing, even if text is left in the input.

usageBubbles.name: Sheet action bubbles
usageBubbles.hint: When someone uses an item, a feature or a roll from their sheet, in any system, a beige bubble appears over the token: "Kirito used Longsword". Only the action's name, never the result.

narrationBanner.name: Narrator bubble
narrationBanner.hint: Every GM narration shows, for everyone, as a black bubble with white text in the middle of the screen, in the same format as the players' bubbles, rising slowly until it fades. When off, narration only goes to the scene history.

narrationBannerDuration.name: Minimum time of the middle bubbles
narrationBannerDuration.hint: Seconds the narrator bubble and the speech with no token stay in the middle of the screen. Longer texts stay longer, up to 30 seconds.

narratorName.name: Narrator name
narratorName.hint: Name shown on narration messages. Leave empty for "Narrator".

narratorActive.name: Narrator mode
narratorActive.hint: Whether this client is currently narrating.

chatTheme.name: Chat theme
chatTheme.hint: Author portrait and color on the roll cards of the chat sidebar. This client only.

migration.name: TBG data version
migration.hint: How far TBG has updated this world.

Bar.label: Chat bar
Bar.placeholder: Type here and press Enter to speak…
Bar.master: Speaking as the GM, in a bubble with no name. Click to turn Narrator mode on.
Bar.narrating: Narrating as {name}. Click to turn Narrator mode off.
Bar.offCharacter: Out of character: select your token to speak as it.
Bar.focusHint: Moves the cursor to the chat bar at the bottom of the screen, to type without the mouse.

History.title: Scene history
History.empty: Nobody has spoken in this scene yet.

Narrator.name: Narrator
Narrator.toggleHint: Plain text you send is posted as the Narrator instead of the selected token or the GM.
Narrator.on: Narrator mode on: plain messages are posted as the Narrator.
Narrator.off: Narrator mode off: you speak as the selected token again, or as the GM.

Migration.tabsContent: TBG now keeps only rolls and cards in the chat sidebar; conversation goes to the bar at the bottom of the screen and to the Scene history. The Custom Chat Tabs tabs are no longer needed. Turn Enable Chat Tabs off now? Foundry reloads the page.

menu.name: Player guide
menu.label: Create guide journal
menu.hint: Creates the "Guia do TBG" journal in this world, a Portuguese tutorial on playing by text with one page per module feature, visible to players. The GM pages stay hidden from them. If the guide already exists, its pages are replaced with the current version.

Guide.title: TBG guide
Guide.confirm: Create or update the "Guia do TBG" journal in this world? If it already exists, its pages are replaced with the current version of the guide; the journal's folder and permissions stay as they are.
Guide.created: TBG guide created in the journal.
Guide.updated: TBG guide updated in the journal.

Errors.noSpeaker: Select a token or assign a character before speaking in character.
